scope: Native review of commit 8012f149 and follow-up fixes in the isolated Record review app, using CUA; not the installed production app.

baseline.daemon: Owned blank-profile daemon on loopback 3002; keyring disabled, fresh HOME and data root, Ollama directed to an unbound test port.
onboarding: Welcome, hosted/local/later model choices, generic Aria identity, empty code-folder selection, extras and review were traversed.
Ollama unavailable showed Start/Get/Check controls and disabled model selection.
Continue without model completed onboarding and retained the optional first-message draft.
No-model Send left the draft unsent and displayed a setup explanation.
Memory readiness incorrectly appeared On from a default enabled schedule, despite missing Ollama; delegated for correction.

portraits.all_eight_native_roster_images: PASS: Librarian, Watcher, Git Steward, Guard, Financier, Forecaster, Council and Grower rendered their current World designs.
portraits.detail_images: PASS: Librarian and Council at detail size, including full headwear. Other detail headers not yet individually inspected.
portraits.world_navigation: FAIL: Librarian Open in World opened Aria rather than Librarian; delegated and covered by eight-ID regression.

setup_handoff: Devices had no paired devices; remote access stayed off.
Have Aria set it up produced an editable, unsent Tailscale request.
An existing visible draft remained unchanged and a pending setup summary appeared.
FAIL: closing/reopening or detaching Chat discarded the composer draft, allowing the pending setup request to take its place; delegated for correction.
Detached Chat Open model setup raised the main window and navigated to Models.
Models had no start/install controls in the baseline; delegated for correction.
automations: All five starter schedules were paused and their cards said Review needed.
Daily Workspace Snapshot detail explained it would not run until Enable schedule was chosen; no enable action was taken.
FAIL: summary claimed Everything is running despite paused jobs; delegated for correction.
baseline.capabilities: Tools surfaced Browser and App Conductor as enabled, Desktop Control as off. This proves visibility of configuration, not tool execution or OS permissions.
baseline.agent_status: FAIL: Scheduler/Librarian counts and disabled Steward were incorrectly labelled Running; pending personas appeared available. Delegated for correction.
baseline.accessibility: PASS: enabled Reduce motion through Appearance in the isolated profile; World destination selection still worked. Down moved keyboard focus from Garden archive to Maker workshop and Enter selected Maker workshop/Steward.

limits: No model inference, model downloads, installer execution, sign-in, remote-access enable, OS permission grants, agent job dispatch or automation enable was performed.
World activity still has a backend recent-session heuristic that can imply working after a blank session is created. This needs an authoritative active-request fix and backend validation.
No claim that every agent task or every app flow works flawlessly.
Native X remains the original unacknowledged close path and can race a last edit; Return to dock is the acknowledged transfer action. App restart persistence is not claimed.
implemented_fixes: Eight current World thumbnails retained; Settings Open in World now consumes the requested character when the view becomes visible.
Agent status counts/enabled flags no longer imply Running; pending personas distinguish unavailable engines from runtime prerequisite probes.
Automate reports paused starters; Home connection label names hub connectivity.
Models adds explicit Ollama start/download/retry and Chat-route selection with installed inventory and live model-list checks; stale status/success cleared on failed refresh.
Wizard memory readiness distinguishes a saved enabled schedule from reachable Ollama and an installed scheduled model.
Composer draft and files survive dock unmount. Initial detach and Return to dock use targeted, acknowledged app events; text/file bytes do not enter window URLs.
Setup request payloads cross window storage partitions, and matching request IDs control consumption/dismissal. Late requests remain pending during a frozen transfer.

focused_tests.note: Separate focused runs overlap; counts must not be summed as unique tests.
